text: 100% recommend this app for planning a routine, tracking all your skincare collection (finally I can document all the things I tried), and checking user reviews of products. The Community forum is also very helpful, people ask good questions and there are a lot of interesting things to learn. Great job!!!
author: Helena Skincare
developer_reply: Thank you for such a beautiful review! So happy to hear you find the Community feature helpful ;) Don't hesitate or each out at contact@feelinmyskin.com if you have any other feedback on the app.
